goals.description: Detect early, weak trend signals across niche digital communities.
goals.underlying_motivation: Mainstream tools act as lagging indicators because they measure volume after saturation.
goals.desired_outcome: Detect acceleration and velocity deltas in micro-communities.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Implement a velocity-delta scoring pipeline to separate genuine breakout chatter from inorganic bot spikes and one-off viral noise.
goals.underlying_motivation: I want to get updated everytime I have new trends about businesses
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Build scrapers/webhooks for 3–5 initial high-signal sources (e.g., specialized developer forums, niche beauty/fashion message boards, early consumer review boards).
goals.underlying_motivation: It's hard to monitor multiple sources
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Wire up an automated daily digest that groups anomalous phrase spikes and synthesizes the underlying trends.
goals.underlying_motivation: Funneling all sources into one places
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Build a test harness for three distinct niches: developer tooling, niche consumer goods, and hobbyist hardware.
goals.underlying_motivation: Finding the things to work on
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Automatically dump daily meeting summaries and screenshots into Google Docs after calls.
goals.underlying_motivation: Don't have to asses everytime and it will be easy for us to monitor our updates
goals.desired_outcome: To make meeting information easily accessible and helpful.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Detect early, weak trend signals across niche digital communities.
goals.underlying_motivation: Mainstream tools act as lagging indicators, measuring volume after saturation.
goals.desired_outcome: Identify trends at the 'cultural edge' before mainstream media or aggregate platforms pick them up, providing an informational edge.

goals.description: Implement a velocity-delta scoring pipeline to separate genuine breakout chatter from inorganic bot spikes and one-off viral noise.
goals.desired_outcome: Quantify and score signals based on acceleration rather than total volume.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Prototype niche data connectors for high-signal sources.
goals.underlying_motivation: Monitoring micro-pools and specific, concentrated spaces is more effective than monitoring the 'big ocean'.
goals.desired_outcome: Ingest data from targeted, high-signal sources efficiently.
failure_modes: Scraping everything blindly, leading to garbage noise and high cost

goals.description: Wire up an automated daily digest that groups anomalous phrase spikes and synthesizes the underlying 'why' in 2 sentences.
goals.desired_outcome: Provide actionable insights by categorizing anomalous keyword spikes and highlighting consumer/tech shifts.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.desired_outcome: Improve the accuracy of signal detection by reducing false positives from bot spikes and viral noise.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

goals.description: Validate the anomaly model with 3 distinct niches.
goals.desired_outcome: Ensure the anomaly detection system works effectively across different types of niche communities.
failure_modes: Handle standard system timeouts and log error alerts

entities.name: Trend Signal
entities.description: An indicator of an emerging trend, characterized by a significant rate of change in mentions within a niche community.

entities.name: Niche Data Node
entities.description: Sources of information from micro-communities (e.g., Korean beauty forum, Discord bot logs, open-source dependencies).

entities.name: Signal Filtering Harness
entities.description: A system component designed to process raw data streams and identify genuine trend signals by filtering out noise.

entities.name: Niche Data Connector
entities.description: Scrapers or webhooks for ingesting data from specific niche sources.

entities.name: LLM Synthesis Layer
entities.description: An AI-powered component that groups and interprets anomalous keyword spikes to synthesize actionable insights.

entities.name: Daily Summary
entities.description: An automated digest of anomalous phrase spikes and underlying trends.

entities.name: Meeting Summary
entities.description: A summary of meeting discussions and decisions.

entities.name: Screenshot
entities.description: Visual captures related to meeting content.

entities.name: Google Docs
entities.description: A platform for document storage and collaboration.

entities.name: Niche Data Source
entities.description: Specific, concentrated online communities or platforms where early trend signals are likely to emerge (e.g., Reddit, GitHub, Korean beauty forums, specialized developer forums).

entities.name: Dashboard Prototype
entities.description: A user interface for visualizing incoming signal streams and detected trends.

constraints.description: Signals must be quantifiable using automated anomaly detection and LLM-powered root cause clustering.
constraints.sla_metric: Automated anomaly detection and LLM-powered root cause clustering must be applied to all signals.

constraints.description: A keyword must cross three standard deviations above its 14-day rolling average to be flagged yellow.
A flagged keyword must sustain its elevated state for over six hours to flip to red.
The automated daily digest must synthesize the underlying 'why' in 2 sentences.
The system should monitor 50 high-signal, inconvenient sources rather than 5,000 generic ones.
constraints.sla_metric: Number of high-signal sources vs. generic sources
